Measured before: cap 5000 with a 361-char preamble returned 5319 chars. After: cap 5000 gives 4967, cap 9000 gives 8971, cap 2000 gives 1982, all within. MY OWN LAW WAS BLIND TO IT because every fixture started with diff --git at position 0, so the preamble branch never executed; a new case fixes that and its red-proof is PROVEN. THE SECOND FINDING IS WITHDRAWN AND I AM THE ONE WITHDRAWING IT. The eye reported that a section with no newline in its first want bytes emits an unterminated slice and merges the next file. I first reported that as reproduced AND worse than stated, with a vanished file missing from absent. Re-tested well-formed, the allocator already behaves: the unusable section is dropped AND named, the neighbour survives, nothing ends mid-line, cap respected.
